title: Real
subtitle: 「真實的／實際的／真品的／正宗的／屬實的／現實世界的」，究竟是哪一種 real？

words.meaning: 實際的；真實存在的；真正發生的
words.note: 強調不是估計、假設、表面印象，而是實際存在或真正發生。常見於 cost、number、result、time、conditions。
words.example: The actual cost was much higher than the original estimate.

falseSynonyms.zh: actual 強調實際存在／實際發生，常與 estimate、appearance、planned、supposed 相對。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The actual cost exceeded the estimate. The ring is made of real gold.

falseSynonyms.zh: genuine 強調不是假的、偽造的或做作的；real 更廣。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The signature is genuine. The problem is real and needs attention.

falseSynonyms.zh: authentic 常強調來源、原貌、文化或歷史上的正宗性。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The restaurant serves authentic regional food. The threat is real.

falseSynonyms.zh: true 主要判斷說法／故事是否符合事實；real 可表示物體、問題或情況確實存在。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The story is true. The danger is real.

falseSynonyms.zh: legitimate 表示合法、正當、合理，而不是單純存在。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The business is legitimate. The building is real, not a model.

falseSynonyms.zh: concrete 表示具體、明確，與 abstract/vague 相對；不等於 genuine。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON We need concrete evidence. The painting is genuine.

falseSynonyms.zh: tangible 表示實質可感、可觀察，或字面可觸摸；不是所有 real 都能用 tangible。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The reform produced tangible benefits. The person in the photo is real.

falseSynonyms.zh: real 通常是形容詞；really 是副詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON This is a real problem. This is really difficult.
